title: Fall of Saigon
summary: On 30 April 1975 North Vietnamese tanks rolled through the gate of the Presidential Palace in Saigon, effectively ending the Vietnam War. A last-minute evacuation of Americans and at-risk South Vietnamese ended hours before. The National Archives says 1.6 million Vietnamese refugees fled the communist regime in the years that followed.

uncertainty.note: The offensive began in March 1975; the event is the capture of the palace on 30 April.
